finalText:
17 call sites pass legacy rounding flag. `src\reports\quarterly.js` has most with 5.

Breakdown by file:
- `src\reports\quarterly.js`: 5 (bundle, holdback, subtotal, surcharge, gross)
- `src\admin\exports.js`: 3 (tip, commission, credit)
- `src\billing\invoice.js`: 3 (tip, balance, payout)
- `src\checkout\cart.js`: 2 (prepayment, writeOff)
- `src\reports\monthly.js`: 2 (tip, settlement)
- `src\billing\statement.js`: 1 (bundle)
- `src\checkout\receipt.js`: 1 (tip)
